report_title: SOC Detective - Correlated Incident Finding Report

incidents.title: Suspicious authentication with related endpoint/network activity

authentication_alert.title: Repeated failed logons followed by success
authentication_alert.reason: 5 failed logons were followed by a successful logon for svc_backup from 198.51.100.23.

evidence.detail: 5 failed logons preceded a successful logon for svc_backup.

incidents.assessment: Suspicious sequence requiring analyst investigation. Correlation establishes temporal and host-level relationships, not proof of compromise or causation.

analyst_conclusion: The synthetic evidence contains a suspicious authentication sequence with related endpoint and network activity. Further validation is required before declaring a confirmed compromise.
limitations: All records are fictional and intended for training.
Correlation by host and time does not prove causation.
The authentication and network source IP addresses differ.
The rules are illustrative and are not production-tuned.
No live SIEM or endpoint collection system was queried.
recommended_next_steps: Validate the account owner and whether the activity was expected.
Review original Windows and endpoint event records.
Verify network connections using trusted sensor data.
Check relevant account privileges and recent account changes.
Escalate according to the organisation's incident response process.
